# BloodLink — Emergency Blood Donor Matching Application

> BloodLink is a community-driven blood donation and emergency matching web application connecting patients and hospitals with verified local donors across Indian states and districts (with deep Kerala district coverage).

## Core Capabilities
- **Donor Directory**: Search verified blood donors by Indian state, district, and blood group (A+, A-, B+, B-, AB+, AB-, O+, O-).
- **Emergency SOS Broadcast**: Real-time trauma and ICU blood request broadcast with audible emergency siren alerts.
- **Blood Request Management**: Create and track urgent blood transfusion requests with hospital location tags.
- **Compatibility Matrix**: Medical compatibility guide for red blood cells and plasma transfusions.
- **Eligibility Screener**: Interactive multi-step health questionnaire checking age, weight, and donation intervals.
- **Hospital & Blood Bank Directory**: 24/7 emergency hospital contact numbers and blood bank listings.
- **Supabase Integration**: Real-time cloud database synchronization with offline fallback storage.

## Navigation & Endpoints
- [Home Dashboard](/) or [Home Dashboard (Hash)](/#/home): Main dashboard with statistics, urgent requests, and quick actions.
- [Request Blood](/#/request-blood): Submit an emergency or planned blood requirement.
- [My Requests](/#/my-requests): View status of submitted blood requests and match responses.
- [Donors Directory](/#/donors-directory): Filter and contact available blood donors across districts.
- [Register as Donor](/#/register-donor): Register as a volunteer blood donor with blood type and contact details.
- [Blood Compatibility Matrix](/#/compatibility): Interactive ABO and Rh compatibility matrix for red blood cells.
- [Eligibility Quiz](/#/eligibility-quiz): Self-assessment donor screener with 90-day cooldown interval guidance.
- [Blood Banks & Helplines](/#/blood-banks): District-wise directory of blood banks and 24/7 emergency hotlines.
